sections.heading: What Strayer is known for
paragraphs: Strayer University-District of Columbia (Strayer) is a private for-profit institution known primarily for its focus on business education. Over half of its academic programs are dedicated to business-related fields, reflecting a strong emphasis on preparing students for careers in this sector. The university has an undergraduate enrollment of 156 students, indicating a relatively small campus community. While Strayer offers various programs, it does not have any programs in health-related fields. This specialization in business education characterizes Strayer's academic profile within the District of Columbia.
